title: Universal Brain 3D v2.3.0 & InkBlitz 3D: Closed-Loop Asynchronous Functionalist Whole-Brain Cognitive Architecture for Partially Observable 3D Environments
description:
Universal Brain 3D (v2.3.0) is a domain-agnostic, 60 Hz closed-loop functionalist cognitive architecture designed for partially observable, dynamic 3D environments, accompanied by the standalone two-stage InkBlitz 3D symmetric paint-territory and core-escort tactical arena (Stage 1: Classic Citadel and Stage 2: Occluded Twin-Flank).

Key components include: (1) an asynchronous 7-process lock-free SeqLock+CRC32 microkernel enforcing strict single-GPU isolation (Barrier 1) paired with Zero-PyTorch C++ /O2 spatial raycast/ballistic kernels; (2) a 4-layer allocentric cognitive field map with stationary-landmark Kalman localization and mid-episode respawn re-anchoring; (3) decoupled 6-DoF locomotion vs. cerebellar 3D ballistic lead-aim and basal ganglia STN-SNr timing control with 0 ms emergency escape bypass; (4) a 3-head multi-step categorical RSSM world model with Dreamer-style perceptual encoder ownership, counterfactual exposure de-confounding, and live UBWM visual/depth verification; (5) metastable Global Neuronal Workspace ignition with straight-through zero-gated (apply_zero_gate) top-down perceptual/hippocampal feedback; (6) Oizumi et al. (2016) lagged causal integrated information (Phi_G); (7) Plan-A motor-isolated grounded inner speech; and (8) single-GPU Population-Based Training (PBT) self-play with progressive Scaffold Annealing (scaffold_prior_scale: 1.0 -> 0.0) and 4-stage offline sleep consolidation (S-1..S-4).
notes: Developed by Alpha496 (Independent Researcher). Includes deterministic 7-stage headless self-verification suite (--mode verify_all) requiring only Python, NumPy, and PyTorch, plus Unity 6 binary wire integration (InkBlitz 3D Stage 1 & Stage 2).
